digest.component_or_area: push.py commit-and-push entrypoint and lock-artifact exclusion
propositions: Concurrent buffered appends to info/exclude can tear patterns mid-line, silently breaking lock-artifact exclusion, risked by two racing first-time callers before write-lock acquisition
Exclusion-write, git-status failures, and lock-artifact presence in committed trees lack direct test oracles covering both strict and default failure modes with typed-error or warning outcomes
Replacing two-write buffered append with single atomic os.write to O_APPEND descriptor eliminates byte-level interleaving hazard on POSIX platforms
Duplicate whole-line exclusion patterns are harmless and remain as deliberate disposition since removal would require a lock the function must not hold by design
